blocks.text:
### Root Cause

Usage folding read only FINALIZED assistant `message` records on both fold paths (python `bench/fa_usage.py`, Dart `lib/src/usage/usage_chain.dart`). A run killed mid-first-request leaves only request-side records (`usage_segment_start`, `model_request_summary`), so usage folded to `0`/`None` and `result.json` reported zeros — the known request-side volume persisted BEFORE the request was never used. Secondary: harbor's `agent_result` never carried a failure-mode classification.

### Fix

- `bench/fa_usage.py`: a `model_request_summary` that never finalized (flushed by a later summary, a segment marker, a session header, or end of chain) folds its KNOWN request-side volume — `ceil((systemPromptChars + Σ message chars) / 4)` estimated input, output unknown — and sets `SessionUsage.usage_incomplete`; finalized requests never double-count. A summary superseded by another summary is counted, not silently dropped.
- `bench/terminal_bench/fa_agent.py`: the fold writes totals from the partial fold and a `usage-guard.json` marker row (tb's closed `TrialResults` model cannot carry an extra field).
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py`: `agent_result.metadata` gains `usage_incomplete` and `failure_mode` (self-kill `agent_timeout` / `external_kill` / `completed` / `crashed` / `never_started`, stashed by `run()`).
- `bench/post_mortem_usage.py`: every row patched from a partial fold is stamped `usage_incomplete` (also on the `null`-tokens degradation).
- Dart: `UsageChainScan.usageIncomplete` → `UsageLedger.usageIncomplete` (serialized only when true, so completed folds stay byte-identical); the dangling-request fallback prices known chars instead of zero-fill.

### Test Coverage

- `bench/terminal_bench/test_fa_usage.py::KilledTrialUsageTest` — evidence-trial REG (session + marker + summary, no message → 2300 est. input + marker), multi-request kill, no-double-count, guard row, harbor metadata/failure_mode.
- `bench/terminal_bench/test_post_mortem_usage.py` — partial-fold rows get totals + marker; finalized rows carry no marker.
- `bench/harbor_fa/test_fa_agent.py::RunOutcomeClassTest` — every terminal outcome class maps (kill/completed/crashed/cancelled/no-cap).
- `test/usage/usage_chain_test.dart` — killed-chain fold, byte-identical completed folds, artifact roundtrip.
- Full suite: `bench/terminal_bench` 427, `bench/harbor_fa` 196, `bench/mls_bench` 51 — 0 failures; `dart test` (default tags) green; `dart analyze` clean.

### Notes

- Never-started trials keep the gh-1638/gh-1576 audit-only precedence — no session, no fold, no fabricated usage (AC3).
- Completed trials are bit-identical on both sides: the marker key is written only when true; estimate paths for finalized messages are untouched (AC2).
- A fully-killed first request names no model, so its estimate lands in the `""` model bucket → harbor `cost_usd` stays `n/a` (same as before; tokens are now honest).
- `bench-tests.yml` (path-filtered on `bench/**`) picks the new python tests up automatically (AC5).

blocks.text:
### Root Cause

Usage folding read only FINALIZED assistant `message` records on both fold paths (python `bench/fa_usage.py`, Dart `lib/src/usage/usage_chain.dart`). A run killed mid-first-request leaves only request-side records (`usage_segment_start`, `model_request_summary`), so usage folded to `0`/`None` and `result.json` reported zeros — the known request-side volume persisted BEFORE the request was never used. Secondary: harbor's `agent_result` never carried a failure-mode classification.

### Fix

- `bench/fa_usage.py`: a `model_request_summary` that never finalized (flushed by a later summary, a segment marker, a session header, or end of chain) folds its KNOWN request-side volume — `ceil((systemPromptChars + Σ message chars) / 4)` estimated input, output unknown — and sets `SessionUsage.usage_incomplete`; finalized requests never double-count. A summary superseded by another summary is counted, not silently dropped.
- `bench/terminal_bench/fa_agent.py`: the fold writes totals from the partial fold and a `usage-guard.json` marker row (tb's closed `TrialResults` model cannot carry an extra field).
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py`: `agent_result.metadata` gains `usage_incomplete` and `failure_mode` (self-kill `agent_timeout` / `external_kill` / `completed` / `crashed` / `never_started`, stashed by `run()`).
- `bench/post_mortem_usage.py`: every row patched from a partial fold is stamped `usage_incomplete` (also on the `null`-tokens degradation).
- Dart: `UsageChainScan.usageIncomplete` → `UsageLedger.usageIncomplete` (serialized only when true, so completed folds stay byte-identical); the dangling-request fallback prices known chars instead of zero-fill.

### Test Coverage

- `bench/terminal_bench/test_fa_usage.py::KilledTrialUsageTest` — evidence-trial REG (session + marker + summary, no message → 2300 est. input + marker), multi-request kill, no-double-count, guard row, harbor metadata/failure_mode.
- `bench/terminal_bench/test_post_mortem_usage.py` — partial-fold rows get totals + marker; finalized rows carry no marker.

blocks.text:
### Root Cause

Usage folding read only FINALIZED assistant `message` records on both fold paths (python `bench/fa_usage.py`, Dart `lib/src/usage/usage_chain.dart`). A run killed mid-first-request leaves only request-side records (`usage_segment_start`, `model_request_summary`), so usage folded to `0`/`None` and `result.json` reported zeros — the known request-side volume persisted BEFORE the request was never used. Secondary: harbor's `agent_result` never carried a failure-mode classification.

### Fix

- `bench/fa_usage.py`: a `model_request_summary` that never finalized (flushed by a later summary, a segment marker, a session header, or end of chain) folds its KNOWN request-side volume — `ceil((systemPromptChars + Σ message chars) / 4)` estimated input, output unknown — and sets `SessionUsage.usage_incomplete`; finalized requests never double-count. A summary superseded by another summary is counted, not silently dropped.
- `bench/terminal_bench/fa_agent.py`: the fold writes totals from the partial fold and a `usage-guard.json` marker row (tb's closed `TrialResults` model cannot carry an extra field).
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py`: `agent_result.metadata` gains `usage_incomplete` and `failure_mode` (self-kill `agent_timeout` / `external_kill` / `completed` / `crashed` / `never_started`, stashed by `run()`).
- `bench/post_mortem_usage.py`: every row patched from a partial fold is stamped `usage_incomplete` (also on the `null`-tokens degradation).
- Dart: `UsageChainScan.usageIncomplete` → `UsageLedger.usageIncomplete` (serialized only when true, so completed folds stay byte-identical); the dangling-request fallback prices known chars instead of zero-fill.

### Test Coverage

- `bench/terminal_bench/test_fa_usage.py::KilledTrialUsageTest` — evidence-trial REG (session + marker + summary, no message → 2300 est. input + marker), multi-request kill, no-double-count, guard row, harbor metadata/failure_mode.
- `bench/terminal_bench/test_post_mortem_usage.py` — partial-fold rows get totals + marker; finalized rows carry no marker.
- `bench/harbor_fa/test_fa_agent.py::RunOutcomeClassTest` — every terminal outcome class maps (kill/completed/crashed/cancelled/no-cap).
- `test/usage/usage_chain_test.dart` — killed-chain fold, byte-identical completed folds, artifact roundtrip.
- Full suite: `bench/terminal_bench` 427, `bench/harbor_fa` 196, `bench/mls_bench` 51 — 0 failures; `dart test` (default tags) green; `dart analyze` clean.

### Notes

- Never-started trials keep the gh-1638/gh-1576 audit-only precedence — no session, no fold, no fabricated usage (AC3).
- Completed trials are bit-identical on both sides: the marker key is written only when true; estimate paths for finalized messages are untouched (AC2).
- A fully-killed first request names no model, so its estimate lands in the `""` model bucket → harbor `cost_usd` stays `n/a` (same as before; tokens are now honest).
- `bench-tests.yml` (path-filtered on `bench/**`) picks the new python tests up automatically (AC5).

blocks.text:
### Root Cause

Usage folding read only FINALIZED assistant `message` records on both fold paths (python `bench/fa_usage.py`, Dart `lib/src/usage/usage_chain.dart`). A run killed mid-first-request leaves only request-side records (`usage_segment_start`, `model_request_summary`), so usage folded to `0`/`None` and `result.json` reported zeros — the known request-side volume persisted BEFORE the request was never used. Secondary: harbor's `agent_result` never carried a failure-mode classification.

### Fix

- `bench/fa_usage.py`: a `model_request_summary` that never finalized (flushed by a later summary, a segment marker, a session header, or end of chain) folds its KNOWN request-side volume — `ceil((systemPromptChars + Σ message chars) / 4)` estimated input, output unknown — and sets `SessionUsage.usage_incomplete`; finalized requests never double-count. A summary superseded by another summary is counted, not silently dropped.
- `bench/terminal_bench/fa_agent.py`: the fold writes totals from the partial fold and a `usage-guard.json` marker row (tb's closed `TrialResults` model cannot carry an extra field).
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py`: `agent_result.metadata` gains `usage_incomplete` and `failure_mode` (self-kill `agent_timeout` / `external_kill` / `completed` / `crashed` / `never_started`, stashed by `run()`).
- `bench/post_mortem_usage.py`: every row patched from a partial fold is stamped `usage_incomplete` (also on the `null`-tokens degradation).
- Dart: `UsageChainScan.usageIncomplete` → `UsageLedger.usageIncomplete` (serialized only when true, so completed folds stay byte-identical); the dangling-request fallback prices known chars instead of zero-fill.

### Test Coverage

- `bench/terminal_bench/test_fa_usage.py::KilledTrialUsageTest` — evidence-trial REG (session + marker + summary, no message → 2300 est. input + marker), multi-request kill, no-double-count, guard row, harbor metadata/failure_mode.
- `bench/terminal_bench/test_post_mortem_usage.py` — partial-fold rows get totals + marker; finalized rows carry no marker.
- `bench/harbor_fa/test_fa_agent.py::RunOutcomeClassTest` — every terminal outcome class maps (kill/completed/crashed/cancelled/no-cap).
- `test/usage/usage_chain_test.dart` — killed-chain fold, byte-identical completed folds, artifact roundtrip.
- Full suite: `bench/terminal_bench` 427, `bench/harbor_fa` 196, `bench/mls_bench` 51 — 0 failures; `dart test` (default tags) green; `dart analyze` clean.

### Notes

- Never-started trials keep the gh-1638/gh-1576 audit-only precedence — no session, no fold, no fabricated usage (AC3).
- Completed trials are bit-identical on both sides: the marker key is written only when true; estimate paths for finalized messages are untouched (AC2).
- A fully-killed first request names no model, so its estimate lands in the `""` model bucket → harbor `cost_usd` stays `n/a` (same as before; tokens are now honest).
- `bench-tests.yml` (path-filtered on `bench/**`) picks the new python tests up automatically (AC5).

blocks.text:
### Root Cause

Usage folding read only FINALIZED assistant `message` records on both fold paths (python `bench/fa_usage.py`, Dart `lib/src/usage/usage_chain.dart`). A run killed mid-first-request leaves only request-side records (`usage_segment_start`, `model_request_summary`), so usage folded to `0`/`None` and `result.json` reported zeros — the known request-side volume persisted BEFORE the request was never used. Secondary: harbor's `agent_result` never carried a failure-mode classification.

### Fix

- `bench/fa_usage.py`: a `model_request_summary` that never finalized (flushed by a later summary, a segment marker, a session header, or end of chain) folds its KNOWN request-side volume — `ceil((systemPromptChars + Σ message chars) / 4)` estimated input, output unknown — and sets `SessionUsage.usage_incomplete`; finalized requests never double-count. A summary superseded by another summary is counted, not silently dropped.
- `bench/terminal_bench/fa_agent.py`: the fold writes totals from the partial fold and a `usage-guard.json` marker row (tb's closed `TrialResults` model cannot carry an extra field).
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py`: `agent_result.metadata` gains `usage_incomplete` and `failure_mode` (self-kill `agent_timeout` / `external_kill` / `completed` / `crashed` / `never_started`, stashed by `run()`).
- `bench/post_mortem_usage.py`: every row patched from a partial fold is stamped `usage_incomplete` (also on the `null`-tokens degradation).
- Dart: `UsageChainScan.usageIncomplete` → `UsageLedger.usageIncomplete` (serialized only when true, so completed folds stay byte-identical); the dangling-request fallback prices known chars instead of zero-fill.

### Test Coverage

- `bench/terminal_bench/test_fa_usage.py::KilledTrialUsageTest` — evidence-trial REG (session + marker + summary, no message → 2300 est. input + marker), multi-request kill, no-double-count, guard row, harbor metadata/failure_mode.
- `bench/terminal_bench/test_post_mortem_usage.py` — partial-fold rows get totals + marker; finalized rows carry no marker.
- `bench/harbor_fa/test_fa_agent.py::RunOutcomeClassTest` — every terminal outcome class maps (kill/completed/crashed/cancelled/no-cap).
- `test/usage/usage_chain_test.dart` — killed-chain fold, byte-identical completed folds, artifact roundtrip.
- Full suite: `bench/terminal_bench` 427, `bench/harbor_fa` 196, `bench/mls_bench` 51 — 0 failures; `dart test` (default tags) green; `dart analyze` clean.

### Notes

- Never-started trials keep the gh-1638/gh-1576 audit-only precedence — no session, no fold, no fabricated usage (AC3).
- Completed trials are bit-identical on both sides: the marker key is written only when true; estimate paths for finalized messages are untouched (AC2).
- A fully-killed first request names no model, so its estimate lands in the `""` model bucket → harbor `cost_usd` stays `n/a` (same as before; tokens are now honest).
- `bench-tests.yml` (path-filtered on `bench/**`) picks the new python tests up automatically (AC5).

blocks.text:
### Root Cause

Usage folding read only FINALIZED assistant `message` records on both fold paths (python `bench/fa_usage.py`, Dart `lib/src/usage/usage_chain.dart`). A run killed mid-first-request leaves only request-side records (`usage_segment_start`, `model_request_summary`), so usage folded to `0`/`None` and `result.json` reported zeros — the known request-side volume persisted BEFORE the request was never used. Secondary: harbor's `agent_result` never carried a failure-mode classification.

### Fix

- `bench/fa_usage.py`: a `model_request_summary` that never finalized (flushed by a later summary, a segment marker, a session header, or end of chain) folds its KNOWN request-side volume — `ceil((systemPromptChars + Σ message chars) / 4)` estimated input, output unknown — and sets `SessionUsage.usage_incomplete`; finalized requests never double-count. A summary superseded by another summary is counted, not silently dropped.
- `bench/terminal_bench/fa_agent.py`: the fold writes totals from the partial fold and a `usage-guard.json` marker row (tb's closed `TrialResults` model cannot carry an extra field).
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py`: `agent_result.metadata` gains `usage_incomplete` and `failure_mode` (self-kill `agent_timeout` / `external_kill` / `completed` / `crashed` / `never_started`, stashed by `run()`).
- `bench/post_mortem_usage.py`: every row patched from a partial fold is stamped `usage_incomplete` (also on the `null`-tokens degradation).
- Dart: `UsageChainScan.usageIncomplete` → `UsageLedger.usageIncomplete` (serialized only when true, so completed folds stay byte-identical); the dangling-request fallback prices known chars instead of zero-fill.

### Test Coverage

- `bench/terminal_bench/test_fa_usage.py::KilledTrialUsageTest` — evidence-trial REG (session + marker + summary, no message → 2300 est. input + marker), multi-request kill, no-double-count, guard row, harbor metadata/failure_mode.
- `bench/terminal_bench/test_post_mortem_usage.py` — partial-fold rows get totals + marker; finalized rows carry no marker.
- `bench/harbor_fa/test_fa_agent.py::RunOutcomeClassTest` — every terminal outcome class maps (kill/completed/crashed/cancelled/no-cap).
- `test/usage/usage_chain_test.dart` — killed-chain fold, byte-identical completed folds, artifact roundtrip.
- Full suite: `bench/terminal_bench` 427, `bench/harbor_fa` 196, `bench/mls_bench` 51 — 0 failures; `dart test` (default tags) green; `dart analyze` clean.

### Notes

- Never-started trials keep the gh-1638/gh-1576 audit-only precedence — no session, no fold, no fabricated usage (AC3).
- Completed trials are bit-identical on both sides: the marker key is written only when true; estimate paths for finalized messages are untouched (AC2).
- A fully-killed first request names no model, so its estimate lands in the `""` model bucket → harbor `cost_usd` stays `n/a` (same as before; tokens are now honest).
- `bench-tests.yml` (path-filtered on `bench/**`) picks the new python tests up automatically (AC5).

CI runs shards on separate machines (matrix strategy → one shard per runner), so this contention never happens there.

A run killed mid-first-request leaves only request-side records (`usage_segment_start`, `model_request_summary`), so usage folded to `0`/`None`. Secondary: harbor's `agent_result` carried no failure-mode classification.

### Fix

- `bench/fa_usage.py`: a never-finalized `model_request_summary` folds its KNOWN request-side volume — `ceil((systemPromptChars + Σ message chars) / 4)` estimated input, output unknown — and sets `SessionUsage.usage_incomplete`; finalized requests never double-count; a summary superseded by another summary is counted, not dropped.
- `bench/terminal_bench/fa_agent.py`: partial-fold totals + a `usage-guard.json` marker row (tb's closed `TrialResults` model cannot carry the field).
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py`: `agent_result.metadata` gains `usage_incomplete` + `failure_mode` (`agent_timeout`/`external_kill`/`completed`/`crashed`/`never_started`, stashed by `run()`).
- `bench/post_mortem_usage.py`: partial-fold rows stamped `usage_incomplete` (also on the `null`-tokens degradation).
- Dart: `UsageChainScan.usageIncomplete` → `UsageLedger.usageIncomplete` (serialized only when true — completed folds stay byte-identical); the dangling-request fallback prices known chars instead of zero-fill.

### Test Coverage

- `bench/terminal_bench/test_fa_usage.py::KilledTrialUsageTest` (evidence-trial REG, multi-request kill, no-double-count, guard row), `bench/terminal_bench/test_post_mortem_usage.py`, `bench/harbor_fa/test_fa_agent.py::RunOutcomeClassTest`, `test/usage/usage_chain_test.dart` (killed-chain fold, byte-identical completed folds) — all PASS.
- Full CI-shaped sharded run (`--exclude-tags integration`, `scripts/test_shards.json` ×4): all shards green — 3126 / 2495 / 2916 / 2561+ tests. Three single-test flakes under 4-way local load did not reproduce on re-run (the ANSI-wrap perf benchmark passes solo). Python suites: 427 + 196 + 51, 0 failures. `dart analyze lib/src/usage test/usage` clean; `crap4dart check --baseline` pass.

### Notes

- Never-started trials keep the gh-1638/gh-1576 audit-only precedence (AC3); completed trials stay bit-identical on both sides (AC2).
- A fully-killed first request names no model, so its estimate lands in the `""` bucket and harbor `cost_usd` stays `n/a` (unchanged; tokens now honest).
- `bench-tests.yml` (path-filtered on `bench/**`) picks the new python tests up automatically (AC5).

### Root Cause
Usage folding read only FINALIZED assistant `message` records on both fold paths (python `bench/fa_usage.py`, Dart `lib/src/usage/usage_chain.dart`). A run killed mid-first-request leaves only request-side records (`usage_segment_start`, `model_request_summary`), so usage folded to `0`/`None`. Secondary: harbor's `agent_result` carried no failure-mode classification.
